title: The Superb view from the ridge
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：superb　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 superb 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the operator wrote of ① a superb view from the ridge in the log, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so superb that nobody in the station would go near it. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the operator, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the superb ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the superb view from the ridge that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log for June 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too superb to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainee who had come to help; the superb ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a superb meal at the inn, and said that no trainee in his right mind would call it ⑥ as superb as the meal at the inn they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was superb or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something superb, and nothing besides. The trainee from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite superb; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the superb ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, before dawn, she wrote of another superb view from the ridge in the same log, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ no less superb than anybody had expected. ⑩ The superb meal at the inn that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the superb ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 极好（前置定语 a superb view from the ridge：1979 年操作员在运行日志里记下的那件极好的景致）
B. adj. 极好／一流（两处加强说法：so superb that … 与 no less superb than …）
C. adj. 极好／一流（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 极好（表语 too superb to do：母亲觉得它太极好，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 一流（前置定语 a superb meal at the inn：叔叔把整件事称作一桩一流的饭菜）
F. adj. 一流（同级比较 as superb as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩客栈里一流的饭菜相比）
G. adj. 一流（后置定语 something superb：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 一流（受程度副词修饰 quite superb：那位实习生的评价）

items.q: a superb view from the ridge
the superb view from the ridge that
a superb meal at the inn
The superb meal at the inn that

answers.why: superb 意为“极好”，1979 年操作员在运行日志里记下的是“一件极好的景致”，此处作前置定语 a superb view from the ridge。
superb 意为“极好”，此处用 so superb that 结构，说它极好到机房里没人敢靠近。
superb 意为“极好”，运行日志上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的极好山脊上极美的景致，等于最高级的说法。
superb 意为“极好”，母亲认为这件东西“太极好了，谁也用不上”，too superb to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
superb 意为“一流”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩一流的饭菜”，此处作前置定语 a superb meal at the inn。
superb 意为“一流”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩客栈里一流的饭菜一样一流”，同级比较用 as superb as。
superb 意为“一流”，运行日志上那半行字要的是“一流的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something superb。
superb 意为“一流”，邻机房来的那位实习生认为这套计划“相当一流”，quite 修饰原级 superb。
superb 意为“一流”，no less superb than 表示“其一流不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之一流不亚于任何人的预料。
superb 意为“一流”，母亲 1991 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的一流饭菜”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，操作员在运行日志里记下了一件极好的景致。（a superb view from the ridge）
它极好到机房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so superb that …）
母亲觉得它太极好，谁也用不上。（too superb to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩一流的饭菜。（a superb meal at the inn）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩客栈里一流的饭菜一样一流。（as superb as …）
到了 1986 年，运行日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件一流的东西。（something superb）
answers: In 1979 the operator wrote of a superb view from the ridge in the log.
It was so superb that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too superb to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a superb meal at the inn.
He said nobody would call it as superb as the meal at the inn they had once had.
By 1986 the log asked for nothing but something superb.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 superb 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the operator wrote of a superb view from the ridge in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the superb view from the ridge that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too superb to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a superb meal at the inn, and nobody argued with him.
The trainee from the next station called the plan quite superb, and everybody laughed.
The superb ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
